SELECT sum(li.l_extendedprice) / 7.0 AS avg_yearly
FROM part p
JOIN lineitem li ON li.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN (
    SELECT l_partkey, 0.2 * avg(l_quantity) AS qty_threshold
    FROM lineitem
    GROUP BY l_partkey
) avgq ON li.l_partkey = avgq.l_partkey
WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#23'
  AND p.p_container = 'WRAP BAG'
  AND li.l_quantity < avgq.qty_threshold
LIMIT 1;

WITH avgq AS (
  SELECT l_partkey, 0.2 * AVG(l_quantity) AS thresh
  FROM lineitem
  GROUP BY l_partkey
)
SELECT SUM(li.l_extendedprice) / 7.0 AS avg_yearly
FROM lineitem li
JOIN part p ON p.p_partkey = li.l_partkey
JOIN avgq a ON a.l_partkey = li.l_partkey
WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#25'
  AND p.p_container = 'WRAP PACK'
  AND li.l_quantity < a.thresh
LIMIT 1;
